title: 1827 Prairie's window hoods, arched attic lights and tower cornice
items: The Doane house at 1827 Prairie now matches its photograph more closely: every front, pavilion and tower window carries a moulded hood, the attic's three lights are round-headed, the corner tower is capped by a deep moulded cornice at the print's height, and the stone front is laid in alternating high and low courses.
